read.title: Subscribe & Save Results – October
read.text:
Team,

Here is a quick update on our Subscribe & Save program. In October, recurring orders made up 18% of total units, up from 12% in July. We're seeing a steady increase in subscriptions for the daily moisturizer.

Retention is also strong. About 70% of customers who started a subscription in August are still active.

It might be worth adding the sunscreen and cleanser next. Before that, we should check stock levels, because subscription orders must ship on time every month.

Thanks,
Minsu

write.model:
Hi Jenny,

We're seeing a steady increase in Subscribe & Save orders. Recurring orders reached 15% of units last month, and retention stays above 65%. It might be worth adding our toner pads to the program next month. I'll check the stock plan first and share it by Friday.

Thanks,
Minsu
